reviewMethod: Independent direct inspection of rendered PNGs; generation prompts and sidecars were not consulted.

background.png.reason: Polished empty seaside radio-observatory at blue hour, with no character, text, watermark, or visual defect.

concept-key-art.png.reason: Marketable adult anime heroine profile with tasteful styling, clear age-23 read, and the specified hair, star pin, cardigan, and blouse.

heroine-neutral.png.reason: Neutral-attentive state is legible, identity and upper-body framing match the set, and the transparent silhouette is clean.

heroine-delighted.png.reason: Open smile reads clearly as delighted while preserving the same adult identity, wardrobe, framing, and clean transparency.

heroine-flustered.png.reason: Blush, averted gaze, and softened mouth make the flustered state distinct without sexualization or identity drift.

heroine-concerned.png.reason: Furrowed brows and settled mouth communicate concerned seriousness while retaining consistent identity, crop, and silhouette.
